text:
ian (support): Hey team, getting an uptick in 502/504 errors from multiple hosted API customers in us-west today. Started around ~2063456700. Customers see timeouts and gateway errors when calling /v1/generate. Examples: request_id=rx-9a7b and rx-9a7c. Can we triage? :warning:

maria (sre): Thanks Ian — I'm seeing a spike on the API gateway with increased 5xx rates and a p95 spike. Linking grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/dashboard/api-gateway?from=2063456600&to=2063457800

cache-monitor-bot: Alert: memcached-pool-usw: connection_errors > 100 in 5m. sample_error: "i/o timeout"

oncall-bot: Paging sanjay (eng-runtime) for high-sev cache errors in us-west :rotating_light:

sanjay (eng-runtime): Acknowledged. Looking at cache service logs. Initial glance shows a bunch of `ERR Connection refused` and `IO timeout` from our KV/prefix cache clients. Also seeing increased retries and spiking latency on the cache client side (avg RPC latency 180ms -> 1.2s).

leo (eng-platform): Any recent deploys to the cache cluster or config rollouts? I don't see new deploys in the last 24h. Could be transient network flapping.

ian (support): Customer repro steps (from one customer):
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-llama-13b", "prompt":"hello", "max_tokens":50}'
```
They get HTTP 502 with body: `{ "error": "gateway error: upstream timeout" }`. They also reported slow responses (10-20s) before failing.

sanjay (eng-runtime): From runtime traces, requests that hit the prefix cache call path are getting blocked waiting on cache reads. When cache RPCs fail, we have a synchronous fallback that tries to hydrate model KV, which multiplies latency. Looks like the cache client pool is exhausted and returning `ERR: pool exhausted` in some cases. Logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T14:17:02Z] cache_client.go:198 WARN read prefix failed: dial tcp 10.2.48.9:11211: i/o timeout
[2026-03-15T14:17:02Z] cache_client.go:206 ERROR pool exhausted: all connections busy
[2026-03-15T14:17:03Z] gateway_proxy.go:87 ERROR upstream timeout after 20s, request_id=rx-9a7b
```

maria (sre): We're seeing connection resets at the VPC L4 in front of the memcached cluster. NACLs/SGs unchanged. Packet drops correlate with times of high 5xx.

leo (eng-platform): Short-term mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag to bypass prefix/KV cache for hosted API in us-west; 2) increase client-side timeouts and exponential backoff; 3) scale memcached nodes or restart the pool. I'd recommend toggling bypass to reduce blocking on cache RPCs and lower 5xx surface.

ian (support): If we disable prefix cache, what's the customer impact?

sanjay (eng-runtime): Disabling prefix/KV cache will increase token generation CPU and GPU cost and increase latency for cache-hit workloads, but it avoids blocking on cache timeouts and should eliminate cache-induced 502s. For most customers, latency will be slightly higher (~50-150ms p50) but stable.

maria (sre): I'm going to open an incident (INC-206345) and start coordination. Action list: page oncall, disable prefix cache via feature flag for us-west, monitor errors, and prepare rollback.

leo (eng-platform): Flag toggle command (internal console API):
```
POST https://control-plane.internal/api/flags/toggle
Body: {"flag":"PREFIX_CACHE_ENABLED","region":"us-west","value":false}
```
I'll run this after we get sign-off.

ian (support): Customer-facing note drafted: "We're investigating increased 5xxs affecting generation in us-west; temporary mitigation may increase latency but will restore reliability. We'll update with ETA." Can someone review & send to affected customers?

sanjay (eng-runtime): I'm going to patch runtime to add an immediate local fallback path that avoids long synchronous cache hydrating for requests marked as LATENCY_SENSITIVE (hot path). Will push a canary to us-west-k8s-canary in ~10m.

maria (sre): Flag toggle executed by leo at 14:32 UTC. Monitoring now.

cache-monitor-bot: Info: PREFIX_CACHE_ENABLED(us-west) set to false by leo at 2063457940

maria (sre): Early signals: 5xx rate dropping ~70% within 2m after toggle. p95 latency for gateway improving. Continuing to watch for residual errors.

ian (support): Great — I'll update the open tickets and send an interim message to the customers we flagged. Any follow-ups for post-mortem?

sanjay (eng-runtime): Post-mortem checklist: root-cause (memcached cluster connection exhaustion + L4 packet drops), why autoscaling didn't react, add stricter circuit-breaker/timeouts on cache client, and consider read-through async hydration to avoid sync hangs. Also add runbooks to flip flag and notify customers.

leo (eng-platform): I'll create a follow-up runbook PR and schedule a capex request to provision extra memcached capacity in us-west if usage stays high.

ian (support): Thanks everyone. I'll keep the thread updated with customer replies. :pray:
